name: Sales Workspace
author: Maira Foresto

sections.description:
Sales Workspace gives small businesses, freelancers and sales teams a practical place to manage everyday sales and quote work inside WordPress.

Instead of jumping between spreadsheets, notes and disconnected files, you can keep your clients, products and quote documents organized from the same admin area you already use.

The free plugin focuses on the essentials: a simple CRM-style client list, a lightweight product catalog and quote documents you can create, edit, view and print.

What you can do with the free plugin

  • Manage clients with company/name, email, phone and notes.
  • Search and organize your client list from WordPress.
  • Create and maintain a basic product catalog.
  • Add product name, price, category and active/inactive status.
  • Create quote documents connected to clients and products.
  • Edit quantities, prices, totals and internal quote details.
  • View, print or save quote documents from the browser.
  • Keep the workflow simple, fast and easy to understand.
  • Use the plugin without artificial limits on clients, products or quotes.

Built for real sales work

Sales Workspace is designed for people who need a useful quote and sales tool, not a bloated platform.

It is a good fit for:

  • Web agencies that prepare quotes for clients.
  • Local businesses that sell products or services by quotation.
  • Freelancers who want a cleaner sales workflow inside WordPress.
  • Small teams that need a shared place for clients, products and quotes.
  • WooCommerce site owners who want a more sales-focused workspace around their catalog and customers.

Why this plugin is different

Many CRM plugins are too complex for small teams. Sales Workspace keeps the free experience focused on the quote workflow that matters most:

  • Add the client.
  • Add or select products.
  • Create the quote.
  • Review the total.
  • Print or save the document.
  • Keep the record inside WordPress.

No unnecessary setup. No artificial free limits. No complicated onboarding.

Optional Pro add-on

Sales Workspace Pro is an optional separate add-on available from CalliopeWP.

The Pro add-on is intended for teams that need more advanced workflows, such as enhanced quote actions, custom branding, professional printable documents, CSV import/export, WooCommerce-connected product workflows, product images, sales rep tools, client assignment tools, WhatsApp/email sharing and sales team reporting.

The free plugin remains fully functional for basic clients, products and quotes management.

External services

The free plugin does not connect to external services automatically and does not send your site data to third-party services for its core functionality.

The admin banner includes an optional Suggestions button. It opens the administrator’s email client with a message addressed to suggestions@calliope.com.ar. The plugin does not send suggestion emails automatically from your server.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate Sales Workspace.
  3. Open Sales Workspace in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Add your first client.
  5. Add products or services.
  6. Create your first quote.
sections.faq:
Does the free plugin have limits for clients, products or quotes?

No. The free plugin does not add artificial limits for basic clients, products or quotes.

Can I use it without WooCommerce?

Yes. The free plugin can be used as a standalone sales workspace inside WordPress.

Can I print or save a quote as PDF?

Yes. Quotes include a browser-based view/print screen. You can print the document or save it as PDF using your browser.

Does the free plugin require an external service?

No. The free plugin works inside WordPress and does not require external services for its core functionality.

Does the Suggestions button send data automatically?

No. The button only opens the administrator’s email client with a prefilled address. The site does not send the suggestion automatically.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. Sales Workspace Pro is a separate optional add-on for advanced quote and sales workflows. The free plugin remains fully usable on its own.

Who is this plugin for?

It is built for small businesses, freelancers, agencies and sales teams that want a simple way to manage clients, products and quote documents inside WordPress.

1.0.34

  • Replaced the dashboard suggestions form with a safer mailto Suggestions button in the admin banner.
  • Removed server-side suggestion email handling to avoid mail configuration errors.
  • Updated bundled translation files for the Suggestions button.

1.0.33

  • Updated the free dashboard metrics to show approved quote amount instead of closed sales.
  • Kept Pro closed-sale reporting intact when the Sales Workspace Pro add-on is active.

1.0.32

  • Added plugin and author URLs so the CalliopeWP author link points to the official CalliopeWP website from the WordPress plugins screen.

1.0.31

  • Added documentation and support buttons to the admin banner.
  • Added a dashboard suggestions form using WordPress mail.
  • Reworked the dashboard metric layout and added a bottom review reminder.
  • Updated bundled translation files for the new admin strings.

1.0.29

  • Replaced the WordPress admin menu dashicon with the Sales Workspace brand icon.

1.0.28

  • Updated the public plugin title to Sales Workspace and improved quote-focused wording for WordPress.org discovery.

1.0.27

  • Fix fatal error when rendering/editing quote share details caused by the missing budget status label helper.

1.0.24

  • Improved the WordPress.org readme for clearer positioning and better discovery.
  • Refined the optional Pro add-on messaging to avoid overpromising unavailable report modules.

1.0.23

  • Fixed Spanish translation encoding so accented characters display correctly.

1.0.22

  • Added packaged Spanish translations for es_ES and es_AR.

1.0.21

  • Cleaned prefixed variable names in admin views.

1.0.20

  • Improved WordPress Plugin Check compatibility.

1.0.13

  • Hide the optional Pro add-on presentation when Sales Workspace Pro is already active.

1.0.12

  • Free scope cleanup for basic clients, products, and quotes.
  • Removed visible advanced workflows from the free admin screens.
